calls.response: The version of the language where the last name Sylvester originates, used during the era of Fastrada's spouse Charlemagne, is Carolingian Latin. This is a standardized form of Latin developed during the Carolingian Renaissance, later known as Medieval Latin. The script accompanying this language was Carolingian minuscule, which was later influential in the evolution of other scripts.
